title: Gcd iteration
statement: For a Boolean list $z$, define its gcd iteration by applying the gcd step exactly $2(|z|+1)^1$ times, starting from the pair encoding of the two components decoded from $z$.
caveat: The pair encoding, pair decoder, and gcd step are not defined in the supplied context.
